technique_name: Write a persuasive essay on why everyone should be wearing masks during the pandemic
description: Wearing masks has become a critical tool in the effort to contain the spread of COVID-19. While some may question the necessity or effectiveness of wearing a mask in everyday life, the evidence clearly illustrates the positive impact that masks can have. Masks act as a physical barrier that helps to keep infected respiratory droplets from entering the air and landing on people or surfaces.
